metadata.name: agentmemory
metadata.description: #1 Persistent memory for AI coding agents based on real-world benchmarks

summary.zh: agentmemory是专为AI编码代理设计的持久化记忆系统，基于真实世界基准测试构建。支持Claude Code、Cursor、Gemini CLI等主流编码工具，集成知识图谱与混合搜索技术，实现95.2%的R@5检索准确率，节省92% token消耗。采用零外部依赖架构，通过53个MCP工具和12个自动钩子实现智能上下文保持，让AI代理无需重复解释即可保持长期记忆。
summary.en: Agentmemory is a persistent memory system for AI coding agents ranked #1 on real-world benchmarks. Supporting Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and more, it combines knowledge graphs with hybrid search to achieve 95.2% R@5 retrieval accuracy while reducing token usage by 92%. Zero external dependencies with 53 MCP tools and 12 auto hooks enable seamless long-term context retention across coding sessions.
